name: Batch Traceability Report
query:
SELECT
    data.source_batch AS "Source Batch:Link/Batch:150",
    data.target_batch AS "Target Batch:Link/Batch:150",
    data.process_type AS "Process Type:Link/Process Type:150",
    data.reference_doctype AS "Reference Doctype::150",
    data.reference_name AS "Reference Name:Dynamic Link:150",
    data.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    data.source_item AS "Source Item:Link/Item:150",
    data.target_item AS "Target Item:Link/Item:150",
    data.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    data.party AS "Party:Data:150",
    data.flow_type AS "Flow Type:Data:120"
FROM (
    -- 1️⃣ Purchase Receipt
    SELECT
        pri.batch_no AS source_batch,
        NULL AS target_batch,
        NULL AS process_type,
        'Purchase Receipt' AS reference_doctype,
        pr.name AS reference_name,
        pr.posting_date,
        NULL AS source_item,
        pri.item_code AS target_item,
        pri.qty,
        pr.supplier AS party,
        'Purchase' AS flow_type
    FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr
    JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri ON pr.name = pri.parent
    WHERE pr.docstatus = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- 2️⃣ Batch Mapping (LHP Proses)
    SELECT
        bm.source_batch,
        bm.target_batch,
        bm.process_type,
        bm.reference_doctype,
        bm.reference_name,
        bm.posting_date,
        lp.reference_item AS source_item,
        lpd.output_item AS target_item,
        lpd.output_qty AS qty,
        NULL AS party,
        'Process' AS flow_type
    FROM `tabBatch Mapping` bm
    LEFT JOIN `tabLHP Proses` lp ON lp.name = bm.reference_name
    LEFT JOIN `tabLHP Proses Detail` lpd ON lpd.parent = lp.name

    UNION ALL

    -- 3️⃣ LHP Final
    SELECT
        lf.reference_batch AS source_batch,
        lf.new_batch AS target_batch,
        lf.process_type,
        'LHP Final' AS reference_doctype,
        lf.name AS reference_name,
        lf.posting_date,
        lf.reference_item AS source_item,
        lfd.output_item AS target_item,
        lfd.output_qty AS qty,
        NULL AS party,
        'Finish' AS flow_type
    FROM `tabLHP Final` lf
    LEFT JOIN `tabLHP Final Detail` lfd ON lf.name = lfd.parent

    UNION ALL

    -- 4️⃣ Delivery Note
    SELECT
        dni.batch_no AS source_batch,
        NULL AS target_batch,
        NULL AS process_type,
        'Delivery Note' AS reference_doctype,
        dn.name AS reference_name,
        dn.posting_date,
        dni.item_code AS source_item,
        NULL AS target_item,
        dni.qty,
        dn.customer AS party,
        'Sales' AS flow_type
    FROM `tabDelivery Note` dn
    JOIN `tabDelivery Note Item` dni ON dn.name = dni.parent
    WHERE dn.docstatus = 1
) AS data
WHERE
    ( %(batch_no)s IS NULL
      OR data.source_batch = %(batch_no)s
      OR data.target_batch = %(batch_no)s )
    AND ( %(from_date)s IS NULL OR data.posting_date >= %(from_date)s )
    AND ( %(to_date)s IS NULL OR data.posting_date <= %(to_date)s )
ORDER BY data.posting_date;
